author: ValWood
body: Tethering is a single step in the fusion pathway. You can re-annotate to the correct transport pathway, e.g. MF vesicle membrane tether part of BP GO:0006888 endoplasmic reticulum to Golgi vesicle-mediated transport MF vesicle membrane tether part of BP GO:0008333 endosome to lysosome transport You can also use child “fusion” descendant terms if they exist, because we may expand the scope of these fusion terms to include the entire pathway of "tethering, docking and fusion at the target membrane”. If you used these, it would be no extra work if we didn’t keep them, because they would be subsumed by the immediate parent term. However, these fusion terms do not always exist; we aren’t sure how to label them, and I’m not completely sure they are required yet. https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0955067417300121
